operation_details.item: The user presented the first concepts to the museum client last Thursday.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Hey, I'm finally catching my breath after last week's client review. Did I mention I presented the first concepts to the museum client last Thursday? It went surprisingly well.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That's great to hear! You'd been refining those for a while, so I'm glad it paid off. Were they receptive to the direction you chose?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yeah, they really responded to the custom craft elements. The visual language feels much more connected to the exhibition's archival material now. The research we completed on their archive made a big difference.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Nice—so combining that archival research with the identity work paid off. How's the type system coming along? You mentioned you were refining it.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Still refining, but it's getting there. I'm balancing legibility with a bit more expressive character. The museum's feedback gave me some new angles to explore.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Sounds like a solid iterative loop. And what about the final presentation deck? I know you were pulling that together for the next phase.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That's in progress—I've been structuring it around the key decisions from last Thursday's meeting. Once the type system settles, I'll drop in the updated visuals.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Looks like everything's moving in the right direction. Any big risks left, or is it mostly polish from here?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Mostly polish, honestly. The main thing is making sure the deck tells the story clearly—from research to concept to execution. That first presentation set a strong baseline, so I feel good about it.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That's a great place to be. It's always nice when a big milestone like that opens up a clearer path forward. Let me know if you need any help tweaking the deck or organizing the narrative.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please forget only that I presented the first concepts last Thursday; keep the completed research, type-system work, and final deck.
